title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette and line styles to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use red, orange and blue bars and lines for sunlight, ground infrared and back-radiation; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette, and dashed or labelled lines, that stay distinguishable in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`, `sessions/session-02/app.html`, `sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All flows distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Session 2 app: show the N-layer temperature profile as a graph
body:
## Problem
The Session 2 app lists layer temperatures only as text when N is larger than 1.

## Context
Seeing temperature fall with height helps students connect the layer model with the real atmosphere.

## Expected outcome
A third graph button that plots each layer's temperature against its layer number, with the surface as layer 0.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] For N = 4 and eps = 1 the surface reads 381 K and the top layer 255 K
- [ ] No JavaScript errors in light and dark mode

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 4: a two-box ocean
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Students ask why the real world has warmed less than the one-box model suggests for the same forcing.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: feedbacks one by one
body:
## Problem
Session 3 lumps all feedbacks into one number lambda.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5. Water vapour, ice and clouds are the heart of climate sensitivity.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where each feedback is a slider and the resulting ECS is shown.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The roadmap checkpoint is met and shown in a figure
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a small climate model checked against the 1850 to today record
body:
## Problem
The Target is a two-box energy-balance model driven by real forcing that reproduces the observed warming; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus a figure of modelled against observed global temperature.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Modelled 2011 to 2020 warming within 0.15 K of the observed value of about 1.1 K
- [ ] Short write-up of your method and data sources

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
